result.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
result.comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including appendix. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/WeightCode
result.summary: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. On ImageNet, four weight programs achieve net gains of 8.84-17.62 points while preserving clean accuracy, outperforming the best of eight fine-tuning methods under matched examples, checks, and retention constraints. In a Vision Transformer, causal interventions show that installed noise-correction gates drive robustness gains, while their selective activation preserves clean accuracy. Rerun on five independently trained Vision Transformers without further language model calls, ten weight programs retain 83-110% of their source-network gains on average, whereas copying their fixed weight edits yields negligible gains. Six programs written for an already edited network add 5.23-14.50 points of contrast robustness while retaining the previously installed noise gain. Together, these results establish WSP as a new route to acquiring and accumulating capabilities in trained neural networks through reusable weight programs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Weight-Space Programming（WSP）框架 WeightCode：由冻结的语言模型编写可执行的「权重程序」，直接读取或改写已训练网络的权重，在不做梯度训练的情况下把新能力（指令组合、新动作、ImageNet 鲁棒性）装入网络，并考察跨网络复用与累积编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其通过写入选择性门控并对权重做因果干预来定位增益来源的做法，可能为 LVR 中「latent/内部状态是否真正被使用、贡献如何分配」的诊断与条件化计算提供可核查的间接线索；但论文本身不研究视觉推理状态生成，联系较远。
